title: A New Estimator of Kullback--Leibler Divergence via Shannon Entropy
summary: We examine the estimation of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the use of the goodness-of-fit test for multivariate continuous distributions. Our starting point is the maximum entropy principle for Shannon entropy: among all distributions with a fixed mean vector and covariance matrix, the multivariate Gaussian distributions uniquely maximize entropy. As a result, the KL divergence from a moment-matched Gaussian distribution to an unknown density can then be written as the \emph{entropy difference}, which is a suitable information-theoretic measure of divergence from the Gaussian…
